prompt: In a vibrant anime style, the scene unfolds at a busy airport gate where natural light floods through expansive glass windows. On the far left, a woman in a teal coat stands firmly, holding a silver suitcase with a white tag attached to its handle. Next to her sits a child in a yellow raincoat, who is looking up at the departure screen mounted high on the wall. A man in a red scarf leans against a metal pillar near the center, checking his wristwatch while a brown dog sits patiently beside his feet. The dog wears a blue collar and looks toward a passing cart pushed by a staff member in a navy uniform. This staff member is pointing at a gate number sign above the entrance. To the right of the pillar, an elderly lady in a floral dress hands a boarding pass to a young man in a black hoodie. The young man takes the paper ticket with his left hand while adjusting his backpack strap with his right. Behind them, a couple shares a moment; the man in a grey suit hugs the woman in a pink skirt, both smiling warmly. Near the window on the right, a teenager in headphones types rapidly on a laptop resting on their knees. A barista in a green apron hands a coffee cup to a businessman in a pinstripe suit who is sitting on a bench. The businessman holds the cup carefully, steam rising visibly. A cat in a carrier bag rests on the floor next to the bench, peeking out through the mesh. A pilot in a crisp white shirt walks past the group, pulling a small rolling bag. He glances at his phone screen. Near the exit, a security guard in a dark uniform stands with arms crossed, observing the crowd. A tourist in a Hawaiian shirt points at a map spread on a nearby table. A nurse in scrubs sits on a chair, reading a magazine. A robot vacuum cleaner moves slowly across the polished floor near the trash bin. There is no snow outside the windows. There is no airplane visible on the tarmac. There is no food being eaten by any character.
